description: Official patronus-ai/financebench open-source sample run with Claude.
run_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m verifiqa run --financebench-dir data/financebench_sample --out runs/financebench_sample_claude --llm-mode claude --model claude-sonnet-4-20250514 --evidence-top-k 5 --limit 5
eval_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m verifiqa eval --run runs/financebench_sample_claude --out reports/financebench_sample_claude
